captions.detailed: A portable floor air conditioner unit with a tall, rectangular light-grey body set on small black caster wheels. The top of the machine features a dark-accented control area with a central rectangular exhaust flap that can pivot open. A front control panel features three small square push-buttons that can depress independently, alongside a circular dial that rotates continuously on its axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a portable room air conditioner. The main body should be a tall, rectangular block with caster wheels underneath and a top control/exhaust panel. Ensure it includes an adjustable exhaust flap, and a front control panel with three independent prismatic buttons and one continuous rotary dial.
captions.factory: The model is constructed by first creating a main body using nested box primitives for the lower cabinet and upper head unit. Four small cylinder primitives are added at the bottom as wheels. The top exhaust flap is built from a thin box and connected via a revolute joint. The front control panel features three small boxes representing buttons, each with a prismatic joint, and a cylinder representing a dial attached via a continuous joint.
